messages:
sara_sales: Quick sync re: ACME POC — they need a 2-week eval to validate latency, cost, and hallucination rate. Questions: success criteria, rough token/throughput numbers, security Qs answered, and a GPU sizing recommendation. Can we align before EOD?

sam_se: Ack. Do we have expected user flow + sample prompt sizes? that drives token math and latency SLO.

ashley_se: Shared earlier: two main paths — "search-augment" and "compose". Typical prompt sizes: search-augment ~ 400 tokens input + 150 output; compose ~ 1200 input + 300 output for long-form. For POC they'll exercise both but mostly search-augment (~70% of calls).

mike_ml: If we assume 70/30 split and target peak 8 QPS (burst 12), baseline 1 QPS, average tokens per request ~= (0.7*(550) + 0.3*(1500)) = 865 tokens/request.

jess_eng: With those numbers, quick calc:```peak_tokens_per_sec = 12 * 865 = 10380 tok/s
per_hour = 10380 * 3600 = 37,368,000 tok/hr
24h = 896,832,000 tok/day```Keeping in mind POC isn't 24/7; expect business-hours load (~10h/day).

ravi_security: On the security front they sent the legal/security questionnaire. Top asks: SOC2 status, data-in-transit/rest encryption, KMS support, VPC peering / private deployment, audit logs, and data retention options. I can own the answers but need infra details (log retention window, KMS provider options).

sara_sales: Good. Pricing ask: they want a rough hosted vs dedicated cost delta for the 2-week POC to decide on Dedicated trial. Any ballpark?

sam_se: Ballpark hosted inference cost for 2-week POC (with these token volumes and burst profile) — assuming effective served tokens ~ 10% of peak 10h/day: rough total tokens ~ 37M/hr * 10h * 0.1 * 14 days = ~518M tokens. Hosted unit cost depends on model; estimate $0.00003/token => ~$15.5k. Dedicated reserved GPU run for same period (2 x A100 80GB nodes, infra amortized) ~ instance hours 336h * $6/hr equiv => ~$2k-3k infra, plus ops. So dedicated likely cheaper for token-heavy workloads but adds setup. These are order-of-magnitude only.

ashley_se: Also call out latency SLO: they want p95 < 350ms for interactive flows. For that we should recommend 2x A100 for pinned low-latency, or 1x dedicated pool + burst to hosted. If they go hosted-only we can configure low-latency routing but higher per-token $$. 

jess_eng: Implementation notes for the POC: set up a canary model route with smaller context for search-augment to hit latency SLO, enable prefix KV cache for repeated queries, and instrument evals for hallucination metric (we need a small eval set from ACME).

ravi_security: For questionnaire timeline: I can draft answers in 48 hours. Need confirmation from infra on KMS options and audit log retention (default 90 days, can extend). Also need contact for on-prem/VPC network owner.

sara_sales: Action items: - @ravi_security draft security answers (48h) - @mike_ml finalize token math and per-model unit estimate (today) - @jess_eng outline POC infra + canary routing plan (tomorrow) - @ashley_se collect 50 sample prompts for evals (today)

deploy-bot: Scheduled: POC sandbox environment provisioning job queued for 1870020000 (infra ticket #4567).

sam_se: Sounds good. I'll capture these in the presales doc and include both hosted and dedicated line items with the rough cost ranges. I'll tag ACME for providing the sample prompts and their desired eval metrics. :thumbsup:

sara_sales: Thanks everyone — let's reconvene tomorrow after Ravi's draft and Mike's final numbers.

mike_ml: I'll post a tiny spreadsheet with per-day token burn and cost scenarios in #sales after I finish the calc.

ashley_se: one more note — if they want encryption keys managed on their side (HSM/KMS), dedicated or private deployment will be required. Call that out in the presales doc.

sara_sales: Perfect. End of thread.
